id_content.d: Penyegaran identitas visual komunitas teknologi Kalimantan Tengah — memadukan perisai Telawang Dayak dengan notasi biner boolean dan sistem logo responsif.
id_content.role: Brand Identity, Art Direction, & Logo System
id_content.body:
NaraiCoder adalah komunitas programmer dan wadah pegiat digital di Kalimantan Tengah. Proyek redesign ini menjawab kendala logo lama yang terlalu rumit dan sulit beradaptasi di berbagai media.

Konsep & Tiga Pilar Filosofi:

  • Telawang (Perisai Dayak): Mengambil siluet heksagonal perisai khas Dayak Kalteng sebagai lambang perlindungan, persatuan, dan ketangguhan komunitas.
  • Regenerasi Lapis Demi Lapis: Garis kurva bertingkat di sisi kiri menyerupai kurung kurawal kode ({) sekaligus bayangan perisai, melambangkan estafet pembinaan talenta dari generasi ke generasi.
  • Logika Biner 1 & 0 (I/O): Elemen titik-garis vertikal ('i'/1) dan heksagon ('O'/0) membentuk notasi biner fundamental komputer serta prinsip Input/Output dalam ekosistem belajar.

Sistem Logo Responsif:

Dirancang adaptif dengan metodologi Responsive Logo modern (Full Lockup, Stacked Lockup, dan Compact Icon) yang siap diimplementasikan mulai dari favicon, banner webinar, hingga sablon kaos dan bordir apparel.

en_content.d: Visual identity redesign for Central Kalimantan's tech community — blending traditional Dayak Telawang shields with binary boolean notation and responsive logo architecture.
en_content.role: Brand Identity, Art Direction, & Logo System
en_content.body:
NaraiCoder is the premier developer and tech community in Central Kalimantan. This redesign addresses the complexity and scalability issues of the original emblem, modernizing it into an iconic, flexible visual system.

Core Design Pillars:

  • The Dayak Telawang Shield: Adopting the hexagonal silhouette of traditional Borneo shields as a symbol of unity, resilience, and cultural pride on the global stage.
  • Generational Layering: Stepped brackets on the flank resemble both code braces ({) and shadow facets, representing knowledge transfer and tech talent regeneration.
  • Binary 1 & 0 (I/O Logic): Vertical line-dot ('i'/1) and hexagonal frame ('O'/0) symbolize boolean fundamentals and the Input/Output spirit of community learning.

Responsive Logo System:

Engineered to adapt seamlessly across scales — from full horizontal banners and stacked event posters to minimal monochrome icons for app badges and apparel embroidery.
